snippet.description:
The definition of a midlife crisis has changed. 

It used to be about clinging to our youth, but now it’s about finally accessing "real adulthood." Amil Niazi, a columnist at The Cut, talks about the new midlife crisis on The Gray Area.

Listen to the full episode of The Gray Area wherever you get your podcasts.
